scope: All 32 IO60 MALDI sections / 18 donor rows in the inventory comparison; six overlapping full-width crops viewed individually. Complements the 32 per-section value/geometry diagnostics in inspection_ledger.json.
limits: Independent thumbnail sizing cannot establish micrometre scale.
Repeated Xenium whole-slide thumbnails cannot establish region-specific coordinates.
Morphology and block metadata are evidence for review, not exact cutting order, adjacency distance, accepted transforms or same-cell links.
No production inspection table, registry or registration acceptance was changed.
